[06-09-2024 Sep 06, 2024 "Streaming Scams, Skift Global Forum's Return, YouTube Against AI Fakes" In this episode of Pepper News AI Edition, host Magnolia Winters breaks down a variety of topics at the intersection of technology and society. We first cover the controversy surrounding musician Michael Smith, who allegedly used artificial intelligence and bots to exploit streaming platforms, raising questions about the ethics of AI-generated content. We then shift to the upcoming Skift Global Forum in New York, signaling a rebound for the pandemic-stricken travel industry. The episode concludes with an examination of YouTube's new policies aimed at protecting its creators from AI fakes, demonstrating the platform's commitment to authenticity and its creator community.](https://music.amazon.com/es-co/podcasts/938e1719-bf05-4f43-ba99-cd5941acb6e2/episodes/639d8019-ca89-4037-bfd9-3a24a50a59a2/pepper-news---ai-edition-sep-06-2024-streaming-scams-skift-global-forum's-return-youtube-against-ai-fakes)
